capabilities: Highlight external edits inline with colors for changed, added, and removed text
Accept or revert individual changes from a hover popup
List all notes with pending changes in a panel, including created, deleted, and moved notes
Navigate and act on changes with hotkeys and commands
Exclude paths, limit file size, and reset review baselines in settings
disambiguation: Not an AI agent itself; it only reviews edits that agents, scripts, git, or sync tools make to your notes and needs no AI service.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux) and requires Obsidian 1.8.7+. Not yet in the community plugin store, so it installs via BRAT or manually. Stores baseline snapshots in .obsidian/plugins/agent-change-review/snapshots/, roughly doubling the space of tracked notes; sync tools writing files directly (Obsidian Sync, Syncthing, Dropbox) show up as external edits unless folders are excluded.
motivation: The author found that agents edit Markdown well but reviewing their work is awkward: split diffs take you out of your writing and re-reading notes is slow, so the plugin keeps review inside the note.
problem: Reviewing edits that outside tools make to a vault means leaving the note for a terminal diff or re-reading whole files to spot what changed.
summary: Change-review tool that highlights edits made by AI agents and external tools inside notes, letting you accept or revert each change in place.
